passages.text:
Hey Mike -- thanks so much for taking the time out to chat with our team. It was very informative and helped folks better
understand the processes and types of work you are doing in the field. I think having this more structured discussion and
us, getting our acts together in terms of how we more intentionally work on this problem set, and engage with platforms, I
hope, will be a net good. We will get back to you soon with a draft document to help us clarify the areas where we think
USAID can be engaging.
Best, Josh

Re: Meeting with USAID
[contact omitted] Joshua Machleder Friday, April 16, 2021 at 11:28:53 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Mike Bradow
Hey Mike -- thanks so much for taking the time out to chat with our team. It was very informative and helped folks better
understand the processes and types of work you are doing in the field. I think having this more structured discussion and
us, getting our acts together in terms of how we more intentionally work on this problem set, and engage with platforms, I
hope, will be a net good. We will get back to you soon with a draft document to help us clarify the areas where we think
USAID can be engaging.
Best, Josh
